examples.text: Obwohl krank, ging er zur Schule.
examples.en: He was sick, but he went to school.

examples.text: Obwohl er müde war, arbeitete er.
examples.en: Even though he was tired, he worked.

examples.text: Obwohl es regnete, ging ich raus.
examples.en: Although it was raining, I went out.

examples.text: Obwohl die Sonne schien, war es kalt.
examples.en: Although the sun was out, it was cold.

examples.text: Obwohl es sehr spät war, arbeitete er weiter.
examples.en: Though it was very late, he went on working.
